name: dynamic-router-control
title: Dynamic Router Control
description: The Dynamic Router control endpoint for operations that allow routing participants to subscribe or unsubscribe to participate in dynamic message routing.
label: messaging

properties.name: lazyStartProducer
properties.label: producer,advanced
properties.description: Whether the producer should be started lazy (on the first message). By starting lazy you can use this to allow CamelContext and routes to startup in situations where a producer may otherwise fail during starting and cause the route to fail being started. By deferring this startup to be lazy then the startup failure can be handled during routing messages via Camel's routing error handlers. Beware that when the first message is processed then creating and starting the producer may take a little time and prolong the total processing time of the processing.

properties.name: destinationUri
properties.label: control
properties.description: The destination URI for exchanges that match.

properties.name: predicateBean
properties.label: control
properties.description: A Predicate instance in the registry.

properties.name: subscriptionId
properties.label: control
properties.description: The subscription ID; if unspecified, one will be assigned and returned.

properties.name: allowPredicateFromMessage
properties.label: control,security
properties.description: Whether the subscription predicate, and the language used to compile it, may be taken from the incoming control message. When disabled, the predicate and expressionLanguage configured on this endpoint are used instead. Enabling this lets the sender of a control message choose both the expression language and the expression that the Dynamic Router compiles into a live predicate, so only enable it when control messages come from a trusted source.
